name: Rheon Automatic Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Rheon Automatic Machinery Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and supplies a range of food processing machines in Japan and internationally. It operates through two segments: Food Processing Machinery Manufacturing and Sales Business, and Food Manufacturing and Sales Business. The company provides encrusting machines comprising single and multi-row models, options, and peripheral equipment; and bread making machines such as line; and related equipment for producing confectioneries, breads, savory, and pastry.
